correctness.rationale: For genuine transmission-rate noise, the diffusion vector is \(q(-1,1)^T\), so \(BB^T=q^2\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix}\). For the source's independent drivers and amplitudes \(q,-q\), \(BB^T=q^2I_2\). The forward operator therefore differs by the mixed term \(-\partial_{SI}(q^2f)\), and the transmission contribution to the quadratic variation of \(S+I\) is respectively zero and \(2q^2dt\). These identities were replayed from the bundled checker with an exact rational witness. The claim is restricted to \(q\neq0\) and does not assert downstream control magnitudes.

value.rationale: The mismatch changes the principal diffusion tensor of the Fokker--Planck PDE actually optimized in the numerical experiments: rank two diagonal diffusion is substituted for the rank-one internal-transfer diffusion, and a structural conservation diagnostic for transmission noise is lost. Because the paper's simulations explicitly use this diffusion to model infection-rate uncertainty, identifying the correct covariance is directly relevant to interpretation and to any reproduction or extension of the control calculations; it is not an arbitrary normalization check.
